$comment: task-infra-seo-gates — Lighthouse CI gate for apps/landing (cheekycheese.tech). Used by .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml for both the mobile and desktop matrix legs; desktop applies --collect.settings.preset=desktop as a CLI override (see workflow comment). Thresholds: 0.90 on all four categories per owner requirement — a regression below this red-flags the PR, it does not silently pass. aggregationMethod MUST stay 'median' (task requirement: '3 прогона, медиана') — @lhci/utils/src/assertions.js defaults minScore assertions to aggregationMethod 'optimistic', which takes the BEST of the N runs (Math.max), not the median; verified empirically (3 local runs scored 85/86/92 on performance — 'optimistic' silently passed a 0.9 threshold on the max value 0.92, 'median' correctly evaluates against 86). Do not remove this key assuming it is redundant with numberOfRuns.

collect.$comment: Explicit url list disables LHCI's file-path autodiscovery (which would also score 404.html — a page that is CORRECTLY noindex and thus can never pass categories:seo>=0.9). localhost port is substituted by LHCI's static server at runtime. Add prerendered vacancy URLs here only if a stable fixture vacancy ever exists at CI build time.
